name: Camp Narache
summary: Young tauren begin their training at Camp Narache, high on Red Cloud Mesa in southern Mulgore. The camp is the Hawkwind tribe’s ancestral home, where elders preserve old ways as quilboar press close and centaur scouts linger.

sections.title: Heart of the Hawkwind Tribe
sections.body: Camp Narache sits at the northern edge of Red Cloud Mesa, the main settlement of the Hawkwind tribe. Hide lodges and pavilions house the wounded, store weapons, bake bread, and offer a place for meditation and communion with ancestors. At the camp’s heart, elders and path trainers gather in a circle. Greatmother Hawkwind guides the newly initiated as they take up their roles as defenders of the Earth Mother.

sections.title: A Proving Ground Under Threat
sections.body: Steep cliffs shield Camp Narache, but threats reach the mesa all the same. Bristleback quilboar from Brambleblade Ravine press into Hawkwind lands, while centaur scouts remain in the distance. Young hunters, shamans, druids, and warriors prove their mettle by thinning aggressive wildlife, guarding the village well, and driving back quilboar raiders. Then they descend the grand path into Mulgore’s wider valleys.

faq.answer: Young tauren begin their training at Camp Narache, atop Red Cloud Mesa in southern Mulgore. The camp is the Hawkwind tribe’s main settlement, where hunters, warriors, druids, and shamans learn their crafts before traveling to Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff.
Greatmother Hawkwind guides the tribe alongside Chief Hawkwind, who leads the braves and coordinates the mesa’s defenses. The elders and trainers gather at the camp’s center to instruct the young.

faq.q: What threats does the camp face?
faq.answer: Bristleback quilboar from Brambleblade Ravine to the east harass the camp. Battleboars and striders roam the surrounding bluffs, and centaur bands remain a threat.

faq.q: Can travelers easily leave the mesa?
faq.answer: Steep cliffs bound Red Cloud Mesa, and a guarded mountain path leads north into Mulgore’s plains. Hawkwind braves watch the way to keep hostile beasts and quilboar from ambushing travelers.

angles.text: As a tauren, you begin your rites of the hunt on this sacred earth and attune yourself to ancestral spirits under the Hawkwind elders’ watch.
As a young shaman, you take your first steps on the spiritual path here, facing trials to earn your Earth Totem and speak with the mesa’s elementals.
